stores.name: fresh
deeds: Score a hand worth 40 or more.
Win a round on the cut alone.
Make the best possible keep 5 times in one run.
Clear a round at triple the target.
Break three marked cards in one run.
Finish a round with fewer than 30 cards.
Hold two Hallowed charms at once.
Score 60 or more from a single Crib.
Clear a run on Street II.
Clear a run on Street III.

marks: THE GALLERY
Marks sit on individual cards and change what they do.
Sunlit
+6 base whenever this card is counted.
Brittle
x1.4 mult when counted. 1 in 4 chance it breaks for good.
Mimic
Wears any suit it likes, for flushes.
Offering
+0.6 mult, but only if you give it to the Crib.
Minted
+3 Glim each time it is counted.
Fickle
1 in 4 chance of +25 base. Otherwise nothing.
backs: Card backs, bought from the Peddler with Pegs. Tap an owned back to equip it.
meld: RUNS: +9 base and x2.0 mult. But pairs score half.
FIFTEENS: each one adds +0.2 mult. Stack them.
FLUSHES: 3-card flushes count, x2.1 mult, and you start with two Mimic cards.
BIG HANDS: dealt 7, keep 5. Your deck starts 20 cards lighter, and everything scores at 0.85 mult.
spoil: All 17 Spoilers. Five are drawn per run, so no two runs meet the same set.
One suit turns to ash. Those cards are inert.
Runs score nothing, and pairs score half.
10 cards are stolen from your deck.
You start the round with no Glim.
Your multiplier is capped at x4.
One fewer deal, and no mulligans.
Your deck is cut to 30 cards for this round.
Fifteens score 1, flushes and nobs score nothing.

tutorial: You're dealt six. Choose the four you'll count and tap them. The other two are thrown to your Crib.
Only after you commit is a fifth card cut. It joins your four for the count, so keep for what's LIKELY, not what's certain.
Your first four thrown cards form the Crib. It scores for you at the end of the round. Feeding it well is a second skill.
Every pair of cards adding to fifteen scores 2. Pairs score 2. Runs of three or more score their length. Flushes and his-nobs score too.
Charms multiply your count. Marks sit on individual cards. Buy both at the Peg House between rounds. You have five charm slots, so choose.
Every third round is a Spoiler with a rule that breaks something. You can see all five at the start of a run. Build for them.
